abstraction: single-top loosely-timed TLM-2.0 pure function model

interfaces.apb: 32-bit TLM target compatible with the data-flow SystemC control boundary

algorithm_adapter: dsc_function_tlm::VesaReferenceCodec::encode backed by the VESA DSC 1.67 C model

qualified_profile.comparison: VESA CLI payload == C++ adapter payload == single-top TLM payload, byte exact

golden_policy.missing_codec: return TLM_GENERIC_ERROR_RESPONSE and emit no bitstream
golden_policy.non_golden_codec: reject in default mode and emit no bitstream
golden_policy.test_codec: allowed only with require_golden_codec=false; outputs remain algorithm_placeholder=true
golden_policy.vesa_adapter: approval is an explicit constructor argument and is enabled only inside a passed differential run

verification_order: golden software codec against authoritative DSC vectors
data-flow SystemC against golden software codec with identical frame/PPS inputs
mixed SystemC/Verilator substitutions against the same golden outputs
all-Verilator or repaired RTL against the same golden outputs
